newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH AIR CARRIER LOT TO OFFER MORE FLIGHTS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH AIR CARRIER LOT TO OFFER MORE FLIGHTS.

text.p: Poland's national air-carrier LOT SA said on Monday it would increase the number of flights in the winter season starting October 29.
It said in a statement it would raise the number of flights from Warsaw to Berlin to 13 a week from the current six while to Prague to 12 from the current 10.
It would boost the number of connections to Frankfurt from the southern cities of Katowice and Wroclaw to 11 a week from eight now.
LOT said that in the winter season, lasting until March 29 it would altogether have 735 more medium-range flights and 100 more long-range flights. It will also add 220 domestic flights.
